tasks.check: deno fmt --check && deno lint && deno check main.ts main_webview.ts scripts/build_windows.ts && deno test --permit-no-files --permission-set=app
tasks.build:linux: deno desktop --exclude-unused-npm --permission-set=app --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --icon assets/icon.png --output dist/linux/DSH-Desktop main.ts
tasks.build:windows: deno task build:windows:cef && deno task build:windows:webview
tasks.build:macos:aarch64: deno desktop --exclude-unused-npm --permission-set=app --target aarch64-apple-darwin --icon assets/icon.icns --output dist/macos/aarch64/DSH-Desktop.app main.ts
tasks.build:macos:x86_64: deno desktop --exclude-unused-npm --permission-set=app --target x86_64-apple-darwin --icon assets/icon.icns --output dist/macos/x86_64/DSH-Desktop.app main.ts
tasks.package:linux: deno desktop --exclude-unused-npm --permission-set=app --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --icon assets/icon.png --output dist/linux/DSH-Desktop.AppImage main.ts
tasks.package:windows: deno task package:windows:cef && deno task package:windows:webview
tasks.package:macos:aarch64: deno task build:macos:aarch64 && tar -czf dist/macos/DSH-Desktop-macos-aarch64.tar.gz -C dist/macos/aarch64 DSH-Desktop.app
tasks.package:macos:x86_64: deno task build:macos:x86_64 && tar -czf dist/macos/DSH-Desktop-macos-x86_64.tar.gz -C dist/macos/x86_64 DSH-Desktop.app
